dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately 5-7 prominent O-shaped rings are visible along the dorsal ridge, characterized by thin, light-gray perimeters and darker interior cores. The gradient transition is sharp on the outer edge and more diffuse towards the center of each annulus.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid-tone, light-gray pixel clusters concentrated on the lower-lateral and posterior-lateral surfaces, lacking the internal gradient found in the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five most prominent dorsal annuli form a non-linear sequence of obtuse triangles that follow the longitudinal curvature of the upper dorsal region.
